name: lexicon
description: Document-mediated workflow for coding agents. Keeps human and agent aligned on a shared mental model via a small cold-layer XML doc (vocabulary, invariants, bounded contexts, design system): ground before substantive work, crystallize accumulated work into the cold layer on the user's call. Inspired by domain-driven design's ubiquitous language; extends the same discipline to design vocabulary on UI projects. Ships as one skill with six subcommands (bootstrap / ground / crystallize / spec / validate / meta-evolve) exposed as plugin-namespaced slash commands, plus a local web viewer that renders the cold layer and specs.
